From 8746c6c9dfa31d269c65dd52ab42fde0720b7d91 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arunpravin Paneer Selvam <Arunpravin.PaneerSelvam@amd.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2024 18:48:52 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] drm/buddy: Fix alloc_range() error handling code
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Few users have observed display corruption when they boot
the machine to KDE Plasma or playing games. We have root
caused the problem that whenever alloc_range() couldn't
find the required memory blocks the function was returning
SUCCESS in some of the corner cases.

The right approach would be if the total allocated size
is less than the required size, the function should
return -ENOSPC.

Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 6.7+
Fixes: 0a1844bf0b53 ("drm/buddy: Improve contiguous memory allocation")
Closes: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/drm/amd/-/issues/3097
Tested-by: Mario Limonciello <mario.limonciello@amd.com>
Link: https://patchwork.kernel.org/project/dri-devel/patch/20240207174456.341121-1-Arunpravin.PaneerSelvam@amd.com/
Acked-by: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>
Reviewed-by: Matthew Auld <matthew.auld@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Arunpravin Paneer Selvam <Arunpravin.PaneerSelvam@amd.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240214131853.5934-1-Arunpravin.PaneerSelvam@amd.com
Signed-off-by: Christian König <christian.koenig@amd.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_buddy.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_buddy.c
index f57e6d74fb0e..c1a99bf4dffd 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_buddy.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_buddy.c
@@ -539,6 +539,12 @@ static int __alloc_range(struct drm_buddy *mm,
 	} while (1);
 
 	list_splice_tail(&allocated, blocks);
+
+	if (total_allocated < size) {
+		err = -ENOSPC;
+		goto err_free;
+	}
+
 	return 0;
 
 err_undo:
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/gpu/drm/drm_buddy.c`**
- Added error handling in the `__alloc_range` function.
- Introduced a check to compare `total_allocated` with `size`. If `total_allocated` is less than `size`, the function now sets `err` to `-ENOSPC` and jumps to the error handling section (`goto err_free`).

### Relationships
The modifications in `drm_buddy.c` address a bug where the `alloc_range()` function incorrectly returned success even when it failed to allocate the required memory blocks. By implementing the new error handling logic, the patch ensures that the function correctly returns an error code (`-ENOSPC`) when the allocation is insufficient, thereby preventing potential display corruption issues reported by users. This change is a direct fix to the previously introduced functionality from commit `0a1844bf0b53`, which aimed to improve contiguous memory allocation.
